Are the items at /warp shop the only items that we can sell, or are there other ways to sell different items?

The answer to this is "no, there are other ways to sell different items." However, the admin shops at the shop warp (AKA spawn) are probably the most reliable, even though the variety sucks.

There are two ways outside of this to sell items, you can:

1) Try to find a player-run shop that is buying items. I think I saw one at /warp pier, but don't quote me. This is uncommon because most players would rather receive money than give it away unless it was for a very specific good (or a generic good in HUGE quantities, but in these cases bartering is usually simpler), or...

2) Open your own shop. This requires familiarity with the plugin, but on the other hand careful marketing and competitive pricing can earn you mad stacks of (virtual) cash if you put your own greed aside just enough to attract customers.

I'm going to go off on a tangent here about that second option, since a lot of players (looking at you, Teamblast, selling a stack of cobble for 250) don't quite understand the relationship between value and greed. When a player goes to a shop, he or she is going to weigh several options before making a purchase. Among these include but are not limited to "is this the best value that I can find for this item?," "How badly do I need this item (am I going to get my money's worth)?," and, most importantly, "Is it worth more to me to buy this item now, rather than to go out and fetch it on my own?" Rarer items are going to be much easier to justify buying. Uncommon items need a bit of thought put into them (An example of this is Duey formerly selling packed ice blocks for 10/$25. Knowing that cobblestone is worth about $0.46 each thanks to the admin shop, I did the math and found that each block of packed ice was priced at $2.50 each, or in Layman's Terms, each packed ice was priced at a little over 5 cobblestone. Do I think this is a good deal? Absolutely! I cleared him out, hence the "formerly selling."), but can ultimately be sold with competitive pricing. Common blocks, however, you really need to be smart about, since competition for them is high. Selling cobblestone, for example, is very risky because selling it for less than $30 a stack means that you lose an opportunity to make money (since the admin shop buys it for $30 a stack), and anything higher means that you're competing with the Miner's Guild, who offer it for free, which, frankly, surprises me (before you get any ideas, though, consider that a couple hundred dollars isn't worth getting the whole server to hate you because you were greedy and robbed everyone of a community resource)! Just my two cents, though.
